id: title:Gilbert09:keep exhausted 429 retries out of error tracking

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a helper to recognize HTTP 429 Client Error as a retryable status, potentially supporting warehouse ingestion workflows.
review.reason: Adds a narrow, localized utility: a new method returning a set containing the string '429 Client Error' and a corresponding unit test. This could support distinguishing transient rate-limit errors for automatic retries in warehouse ingestion, but the implementation is narrow and does not demonstrate broader systemic changes or complete workflow behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds a new method get_retryable_errors returning a set containing the string '429 Client Error' and a corresponding unit test asserting that the 429 error message is recognized as retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a Temporal workflow for Iterable warehouse ingestion by distinguishing between transient rate-limit errors that should trigger automatic retries versus other failures, potentially improving recovery and reducing alert fatigue. The implementation is narrow and does not demonstrate broader systemic changes or complete workflow behavior.
